feedback.finish: A heatwave is when the temperature of an area is much higher than usual for at least three days. However, heatwaves can last much longer than this.

atoms.a: In which season do you think heatwaves are most common?

feedback.finish: Heatwaves usually occur in the summer, when average temperatures are already at their highest. The highest temperature ever recorded in the UK was during a 2022 heatwave, when temperatures rose to above 40°C!

atoms.text: When there is a lot less rain than normal over a long period of time, this is known as a drought.
During droughts, grass turns from green to brown due to a lack of water, and crops dry out or fail to grow. In extreme cases, rivers and lakes begin to dry up, and trees begin to die.
Heatwaves and droughts often occur simultaneously, as the heat from heatwaves makes water evaporate quicker, which dries out the land.
